verdict.rationale: The SDK enables building custom agents that can read/query data, run code, and return structured insights (e.g., finance agent example, structured outputs, custom tools/MCP for database/API access), but it is a developer framework, not an end-user product with built-in 'insights from my data' UX — the buyer must build that experience themselves. missing for 10: a first-party example/UI showing generated insights presented to an end user, evidence of built-in analytics/dashboards, and independent hands-on validation that the insights feature works well in practice (community feedback focuses on harness/CLI issues, not insight generation quality).
